full_name: Patricio A. Fernandez | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2012–2013 Radcliffe Institute Graduate Student Fellow Harvard University
bio: Patricio A. Fernandez is a PhD candidate in philosophy and economics at Harvard University. His research interests include the theory of action, ethics, ancient philosophy, and foundational issues at the intersection of economics and philosophy.
